description.value: Standard Pizza is a small, independently owned neighbourhood pizzeria on Cook Street in Victoria, serving wood-fired pizzas in two sizes (12" and 16") for dine-in or takeout. The menu centres on classic and creative combinations using quality ingredients, with a flexible build-your-own approach and a strong selection of vegetarian options. Cook Street Village is a lively, walkable strip and a natural waypoint for cyclists moving through the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at standardpizza.ca is live and corroborates the OSM record as an active independent pizzeria; it provides address (1515 Cook St, Victoria, BC V8T 3N7) and phone (250 590 2363) absent from OSM tags. The menu page explicitly states 'take-out or dine-in' and lists a labeled 'VEGETARIAN' pizza alongside several other vegetarian options; no bike parking, washroom, water refill, or tech amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record is missing address, phone, and email — all found on the website (1515 Cook St, 250 590 2363, info@standardpizza.ca); OSM should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a confirmed address and operating menu; a useful food stop for touring cyclists on Cook Street.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a pizza explicitly labeled 'VEGETARIAN' (tomato, cheese, kale, mushroom, olive, onion) plus additional vegetarian-friendly options (TOMATO, KALE, MUSHROOM, WHITE, MARGHERITA, etc.); no vegan or gluten-free options are mentioned
